units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 4:1">Yoma IV, 1</cite> <he>הסגן … מִשְּׂמאֹלוֹ</he> the Sagan to his right, and the chief of the priests’ division to his left.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 4:1">Ib.</cite> <he>אם של שם עלה בשמאלו</he> if the lot marked ‘unto the Lord’ came up in his left hand; <he>הגבה שְׂמֹאלְךָ</he> raise thy right hand. Ib. V, 1 <he>מהלך לשמאלו</he> walks to the left.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 154:5">Sifré Deut. 154</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 17:11">Deut. XVII, 11</cite>) <he>אפי׳ … על ש׳ שהוא ימין וכ׳</he> even if they show it before thy eyes that left is right and right is left, listen to them; a. v. fr.
